title: Transplant Ethics: Distributive Justice and Presumed Consent

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungary operates under the legal principle of *feltételezett beleegyezés* (presumed consent / opt-out): every deceased person whose brain death is certified (*agyhalál*) is considered an organ donor unless they registered an explicit objection in life.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Eurotransplant allocation takes biological compatibility (*szöveti egyezés*), medical urgency, waiting time and, for children, special priority into account; wealth and social status are not among its criteria.
